Use the folders in this pack to store reusable content chunks that can be recombined for resumes, portfolio pages, interview prep, LinkedIn updates, and GitHub project documentation.

title: Cover-Letter-AI-Governance-Microsoft-365
content:
[Your Name]
[City, State]

Hiring Manager
[Company Name]
[Company Address]

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the [Job Title] role. I bring 23 years of enterprise IT experience across healthcare, government, logistics, PBM, retail, hospitality, and managed services, along with hands-on experience in AI governance, human-in-the-loop AI operating models, Microsoft 365 automation, and enterprise knowledge systems.

My work sits at the intersection of operational problem solving, governance, and execution. I identify business and operational needs, define requirements and control structures, and direct AI-assisted systems to accelerate implementation, documentation, workflow development, and knowledge capture without removing human accountability.

I am Microsoft Certified in Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) and the creator of PAIOS (Personal AI Operating System) and AI Neural Governance v1.0. These frameworks were developed to explore governed AI adoption through human oversight, accountability, workflow orchestration, and operational control. This work reflects how I approach AI in practice: not as a replacement for judgment, but as a force multiplier for structured, governed execution.

In addition to my AI governance work, I bring a broad enterprise IT foundation that includes Microsoft 365, Azure, SharePoint, Power Platform, ServiceNow, endpoint support, infrastructure troubleshooting, and technical documentation. That combination allows me to connect strategy, governance, and implementation in a way that is practical for real operating environments.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute that perspective to [Company Name]. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
